source.developerJdkGuidance: Gradle 9.8.2 contributor guide specifies Adoptium JDK 25 for development; fixed version is needed for the remote build cache.

bootstrapEnvironment.reproducibleSourceBuildWithTrustedExtern: POSSIBLE_IN_PRINCIPLE_BUT_NOT_ASSESSED; a previously installed, provenance-verified Gradle could remain a host build tool and stay out of the package payload, but it would be a binary bootstrap input rather than a source-only bootstrap.
bootstrapEnvironment.reason: The official source-build instruction invokes the wrapper, whose pinned source-archive configuration downloads Gradle 9.8.1 binary ZIP without distributionSha256Sum. No Gradle executable is on PATH; only cached 8.14.3 and 9.3.1 distributions were found, with no tracked provenance/checksum evidence and neither matching the configured wrapper version. They were not run.

sourceBuildInputs.note: The source tree includes dependency-verification metadata, but also configures external artifact repositories; no dependency resolution or source build was run.

targetRuntime.nativePlatformEvidence: Gradle's supported-platform matrix lists Ubuntu AArch64 but not Android/Bionic; its file-watching documentation lists Linux distributions and inotify but not Android/Bionic.
targetRuntime.fileWatching: NOT_VERIFIED_ON_BIONIC; Gradle documents --no-watch-fs as a way to disable watching, not as proof of Android runtime compatibility.
targetRuntime.daemon: NOT_VERIFIED_ON_ANDROID; Gradle's daemon is a long-lived background JVM process by default. --no-daemon can disable reuse, but app-private process, local-socket, memory, and lifecycle behavior must still be tested.

decision.nextActionableBlocker: Establish an approved, trusted and provenance-pinned existing Gradle bootstrap compatible with the Gradle 9.8.2 source build, without invoking the wrapper or downloading its binary distribution; then lock/verify all resolved build dependencies before attempting a source build.
